705448.desc: Shrieking Scythe now silences the target for 3.5 sec and causes up to 200% bonus weapon damage based on how low your health is. Fails on silence immune enemies.

705449.name: Torturing Scythe
705449.desc: The Soul Infusion effect from Shrieking Scythe restores an additional 5% maximum health and increases the damage of your next Soulrend against the target by 100%.

705684.name: Ghast
705684.desc: While wielding a two-handed weapon, your damage is increased by 3% and your auto attacks have an 8% chance to make your next Reap guaranteed to critically strike.

706576.name: Bountiful Harvest
706576.desc: Increases the damage of Reap by 25%.

706731.name: Soul Collector
706731.desc: Your Reap generates 1 Soul Fragment. Generating 3 Soul Fragments generates a Reaped Soul. Generating 3 Reaped Souls generates a Soul Infusion, which allows the use of powerful abilties.

706732.name: Icecrown
706732.desc: Increases your allies' critical strike chance against the enemy by 1% for 10 sec, stacking 3 times.

706784.name: Dark Soul
706784.desc: Level 40 Passive Increases your Stamina equal to your Armor penetration rating.

706788.name: Life Tap
706788.desc: Reduces the cooldown of Spectral Warden by -60 sec and it now heals you equal to 200% of the damage it deals.

706791.name: Misfortune
706791.desc: Increases the critical strike chance of Dirge and Murder by 5%.

706792.name: Well of Souls
706792.desc: Damage dealt by Soul Strike and Murder now reduces the cooldown of Spectral Scythe by -1 sec.

706793.name: Well of Eternity
706793.desc: Increases the duration of your Spectral Scythes by 10 sec.

706982.name: Dreadraven
706982.desc: Damage from the Reaper's Soulrend, Dreadwake and Spectre Stride increased by 10%. Stacks 3 times.

706986.name: Counterscythe
706986.desc: Causes Soulwarden's Resolve to also apply Counterscythe for 15 sec.

707095.name: Elemental Secrets
707095.desc: Speak a dark word, healing up to 0 allies within 0 yds for 645 and generating 20 Insanity.

707116.name: Warden of the Lost
707116.desc: Damage dealt by Spectral Scythes and Spectral Wardens now reduces the cooldown of Spectral Warden by -0.5 sec.

707305.name: Blood Wraith
707305.desc: Wraithblade now deals an additional 100% Weapon Damage and its Runic Power cost is reduced by -20.

707455.name: Chasing Death
707455.desc: Deathchaser used against a target below 20% health will now reapply itself at the end of its duration until they die or until 5 seconds passes.

707456.name: Three of Spirits
707456.desc: While below 35% maximum health, your dodge is increased by 30% and dodging an attack unleashes Soul Harvest on the target.

707459.name: Cull
707459.desc: Wraithblade now deals an additional 0% Weapon Damage.

707634.name: Spirit Army
707634.desc: Your Spectral Warden now causes you to summon 2 additional Spectral Wardens, but their duration is reduced by -8 sec. In addition, increases the amount absorbed by the shield granted by Spectral Warden by 100%.

707899.name: Blood Frenzy
707899.desc: Casting Harvest Time with an enemy targeted within 20 yds of you now unleashes a Blood Frenzy.

707908.name: Essence Harvest
707908.desc: Increases the additional Frost Damage dealt by Ghostly Weapon by 10%.

707909.name: To The Shadowlands
707909.desc: Increases the duration of Soulslam by 1 sec.

712390.name: Rift Clone
712390.desc: Slip into the shadows and increase your movement speed by 30%, creating a copy of yourself for 0. Casting does not break the effect however it will drop off at the end of your cast.

712683.name: Fleeting Soul
712683.desc: Reduces the cooldown of Soulslam by -15 sec.

800171.name: Painmail
800171.desc: Increases the threat generated by your abilities by 0% and all healing you take by 35%.

800172.name: Doomrend
800172.desc: Rend an enemy dealing 125% Weapon Damage plus 17 + 35% AP, causing you to apply a dark shield to them that absorbs the next 390 + 200% Strength healing done to them for 5 seconds, and generates Runic Power.

800174.name: Deathwind
800174.desc: Generates 1 Reaped Soul Create a cloud of mist at the target location for 10 sec. Every 2 sec, enemies in the area take 11 Frost damage, healing you for 40% of the damage dealt.

800198.name: Rite of Resolve
800198.desc: Perform a resolving rite upon an ally, increasing their Stamina by 4 for 30 min.

800253.name: The Harvest Lord
800253.desc: When you equip a Two-Handed Weapon, Reap deals 40% more damage and heals for 100% more, but its cooldown is increased by 0.001 sec.

800338.name: Dark Pact
800338.desc: Increases your Attack Power by 150% of your Agility. Reduces your base damage dealt by 20% and increases your damage taken by 15%.

800479.name: The Wraith
800479.desc: When you Dual Wield, Reap| will strike with both weapons.

800797.name: Underwalk
800797.desc: Sneak around in the spirit world, becoming stealthed, but reducing your movement speed by 20%. Cannot be used in combat.

800845.name: Limbo
800845.desc: Rip out of your mortal shell for 5 seconds, making you immune to all harmful spell effects and instantly restoring 30% of your maximum health and Runic Power. Usable while stunned, feared, or polymorphed.

800922.name: Endbringer
800922.desc: Become an Endbringer for 15 seconds, increasing the damage of Dirge by 30%, the range by 20 yds, and causes it to generate 3 Reaped Souls. For the duration, Dirge will heal you for 75% of its damage dealt.

800926.name: Possession
800926.desc: You strike the target with your weapon, dealing 400% Spectral Damage.

800938.name: Corporeal Flay
800938.desc: Flay an enemy's soul with a beam of dark magic, dealing 58.6 to 59.6 Spellshadow Damage every 2 sec for 6 sec. Soul Infusion: Arcs to up to 0 enemies and ticks 30% faster.

801041.name: Red Wake
801041.desc: Draw blood from up to 8 enemies within 20 yds, dealing 118 Shadow Damage, ignoring resistances. Generates 5 Runic Power for each target struck.

801249.name: Reaper Sweeper Cast Visual
801249.desc: Increases all damage done by 10% and total health by 0%.

801328.name: Dirge
801328.desc: Strike the enemy with both weapons, dealing 6 + 15% AP Shadowfrost Damage with each. Generates 2 Soul Fragments and 7 to 13 Runic Power.

801330.name: Reave
801330.desc: Requires Soul Infusion Strike in a flurry of souls, dealing 136.28 Shadow Damage to up to 0 enemies within 8 yds. Deals 90 Shadow Damage over 14 sec, healing for 50% of the damage dealt.

801332.name: Shrieker
801332.desc: Shred the enemy with a shadowy scythe, dealing 1 Shadow Damage and silencing them for 3.5 sec. If the target is silenced successfully, you also deal additional Weapon Damage as Shadow based on how low your Health is.

801337.name: Writhe
801337.desc: Inflict immense pain on an enemy, taunting them to attack you for 3 sec.

801568.name: Dark Conquest
801568.desc: Causes your third Reap to critically strike and generate an additional Soul Fragment.

801624.name: Spectre Stride
801624.desc: Reappear behind your target and ambush them, striking them for 185 Shadow damage and rooting them for 2 sec. Generates 20 Runic Power.

803351.name: Spectator
803351.desc: Sneak around in the spirit world, becoming stealthed, and regenerating 0% maximum health every 3 sec for -0.001 sec. Cannot be used in combat.

803730.name: Greater Mark of Rivendare
803730.desc: Mark nearby party and raid members with the guile of Rivendare increasing their Stamina by 54 and Frost Resistance by 60 for 30 min.

803984.name: Soulspear
803984.desc: Deals 75.8 to 79.8 Shadow Damage to an enemy. If you have Soul Infusion this spell is instant cast, but does not consume Soul Infusion.

803985.name: Ghost Claw
803985.desc: Chill an enemy with a ghostly claw, slowing and stealing 50% of their movement speed for 8 sec. Whenever you kill an enemy, the cooldown of this ability is reset.

803988.name: Spectral Waltz
803988.desc: You slip into the realm of the dead for 3 sec, reducing damage taken by 50% but making you unable to attack or cast spells.

803989.name: Soul Shock
803989.desc: Shock an enemy's soul, sapping them for 8 sec. Can only affect 1 target at a time. Damage dealt will interrupt this effect. Can only be used on Humanoids, Undead, Beasts, Dragonkin. Your first attack against them causes 0% increased damage.

803990.name: Veilwalk
803990.desc: 2 Charges, 60 sec recharge Move with spectral agility, gaining 50% increased movement speed for 4 seconds, stacking 2 times. Removes all movement impairing effects.

803992.name: Dreadwake
803992.desc: Generates 1 Reaped Soul Unleash a wave of souls upon enemies in a 12 yd cone, causing 80% Weapon Damage plus 5 Frost Damage.

803998.name: Ghostly Magic
803998.desc: Increases the damage of Murder and Reliquary of the Lost by 10%.

803999.name: Dominion
803999.desc: Gaining Soul Infusion now increases your Armor by 585 for 6 seconds.

804001.name: Reaper's Pact
804001.desc: You link yourself with an ally, reducing all damage they take by 5% and redirecting 20% of all damage they take to you. Lasts 10 min. This effect will fall off if you are more than 30 yds from the ally.

804004.name: Soulbender
804004.desc: Significantly increases the Runic Power generated by Deathchaser.

804054.name: Deathstalker
804054.desc: Mark an enemy target and increase your speed by 40% while within 20 yds of them for 15 sec. Dealing damage will break the effect. While stalking an enemy, you are able to see all nearby stealthed enemies. Stalking a Humanoid will apply Anxiety to them.

804279.name: Unapologetic
804279.desc: Reave now strikes an additional 5 nearby enemies.

804311.name: Soul Harvester
804311.desc: Landing the killing blow on a target that yields experience or honor now grants Soul Harvester for 10 seconds.

804660.name: Soulrot
804660.desc: Rot the soul of your target, cursing them for 15 sec. At the end of the duration the enemy will take damage based on the number of stacks accrued. Each instance of damage from Deathchaser adds 1 stack to this effect, up to 20 stacks. Dispelling this effect causes the dispeller to instantly take 1200 Shadow Damage.

804697.name: Possessed
804697.desc: Stuns the target for 0 and deals Shadow Damage.

805077.name: Soul Fragment
805077.desc: At 5 stacks, generate a Reaped Soul.

805171.name: Wraithscythe
805171.desc: Swing your Scythe around, dealing Weapon Damage plus180 to nearby enemies, plus 1 Shadow Damage scaling with your Attack Power, and Spell Power to a lesser extent.

805181.name: Eater of Souls
805181.desc: Reaching 3 Reaped Souls now reduces your Physical Damage taken by -10% and you regain 1% of your maximum health every 2 sec for 10 seconds. This will not trigger while already active. In addition, the healing done by Deathwind is increased by 10%.

805184.name: Soul Furnace
805184.desc: Increases the amount leeched from Soul Harvest by an additional 50%.

805185.name: Sinister Litany
805185.desc: Embrace your sinister thoughts, instantly generating 3 Reaped Souls.

805186.name: Essence Invigoration
805186.desc: Casting abilities that require Soul Infusion now has a 50% chance to restore 5% of your missing health.

805188.name: Harvester's Scythe
805188.desc: Increases the amount leeched by Soul Strike by 15%.

805190.name: Deathchaser
805190.desc: Force death upon an enemy, dealing 5 + 8% AP Shadowfrost Damage, repeating every 0 sec for 1 seconds, and generates Runic Power.

805192.name: Ghastly Advance
805192.desc: Increases the range of Spectre Stride by 5 yds and causes it to generate 5 more Runic Power.

805193.name: Edgewalker
805193.desc: Reduces all damage taken by 60% and increases all healing done by 15% for 6 sec. While this is active you are considered Undead, making you immune to fear, sleep, and charm effects.

805194.name: Lord of Death
805194.desc: Abilities affected by Ghostly Weapon now deal 25% more damage per additional target.

805198.name: Ruin
805198.desc: Damage dealt by Murder now applies Ruin to enemies for 10 seconds.

805202.name: Embrace of Death
805202.desc: Increases damage dealt by Deathchaser by 25%.

805203.name: Mawborn
805203.desc: Reduces the duration of disarm and incapacitate effects against you by -20%.

805204.name: Maw Knight
805204.desc: Increases the critical strike chance of Doomrend by 5%.

805208.name: Boots of Speed
805208.desc: Grants 20% increased Movement Speed, and 100% increased Mounted Movement Speed.

805211.name: Power of the Titans
805211.desc: Increases your damage by 5%, healing by 5%, and Maximum Health by 8%.

805212.name: Titan's Favor
805212.desc: When this reaches 100 stacks, consume them and gain an additional level of Power of the Titans, boosting your damage, health, and healing. You can gain stacks of this effect by completing map objectives and killing enemies.

805213.name: Blessing of the Blue
805213.desc: Health and Mana Regeneration increased by 25%. Cost of spells and abilities reduced by 25%.

805214.name: Blessing of the Black
805214.desc: Damage done increased by 10%, damage taken reduced by 15%. Immune to Stun effects.

805215.name: Khadgar's Whim
805215.desc: Increases your Maximum Mana by 20%. Every 20 sec, you gain a stack of Archmage, increasing your Spell Haste by 5%, stacks up to 15 times. These stacks are lost on death. This is a Weapon Item, and cannot be used alongside other Weapon Items.

805217.name: Sorcerer's Gloves
805217.desc: Increases your Spell Damage by 328, and your Maximum Mana by 10%. This is a Glove Item, and cannot be used alongside other Glove Items.

805218.name: Warmonger's Gloves
805218.desc: Increases your Physical Damage dealt by 8%. This is a Glove Item, and cannot be used alongside other Glove Items.

805219.name: Crown of Rhonin
805219.desc: Increases your total Magic Damage done by 50%. This is a Head Item, and cannot be used alongside other Head Items.

805220.name: Spellbreaker's Warhelm
805220.desc: Increases your Magic Resistance by 30%. Every 30 sec, you gain a shield that reduces the damage you take from the next 3 Magical Attacks by 95%. While this shield holds, all damage you deal is increased by 15%. This is a Head Item, and cannot be used alongside other Head Items.

805222.name: Dragonguard's Helm
805222.desc: Increases your Maximum Health by 30%, and your Armor by 49%. This is a Head Item, and cannot be used alongside other Head Items.

805223.name: Ravenholdt Shroud
805223.desc: Increases your Critical Strike Chance by 20%. Dealing damage to an enemy player Marks them for -0.001 sec, increasing all damage they take by 20%. This effect cannot occur more than once every minute. This is a Head Item, and cannot be used alongside other Head Items.

805225.name: Crown of Zovaal
805225.desc: Dealing Shadow Damage to an enemy increases your Shadow Damage dealt by 8% for 4 sec, stacks up to 20 times. While at 20 stacks, your Shadow Damage effects always critically strike. This is a Head Item, and cannot be used alongside other Head Items.

805228.name: Uther's Crown
805228.desc: Increases all Healing you do by 20%, and your Armor by 29%. Makes you Immune to Power Burn effects. This is a Head Item, and cannot be used alongside other Head Items.

805229.name: Lichknife
805229.desc: Dealing Magic Damage to an enemy increases all Periodic Damage they take by 20%, and burns them for 0% of their Maximum Health over 3 sec. Increases your Magic Resistance by 15%. This is a Weapon Item, and cannot be used alongside other Weapon Items.

805231.name: Pulverizeer's Fists
805231.desc: While moving you build up a powerful attack. Your next Melee Auto Attack will unleash the attack, dealing bonus Physical Damage based on the distance travelled. This is a Glove Item, and cannot be used alongside other Glove Items.

805258.name: Wraithblade
805258.desc: Generates 3 Reaped Souls Strike for 150% Weapon Damage plus 44 Shadow Damage, ignoring resistances, absorption, and invulnerability effects.

805340.name: Blood Siphon
805340.desc: Requires Soul Infusion Siphon blood from enemies, dealing 142.8 Shadow Damage to up to 0 enemies within 0 yds, healing for 25% of the damage dealt.

805709.name: Crimson Thirst
805709.desc: At 10 stacks your next Murder transforms into Shudder Scythe for 10 sec.

805711.name: Soulshroud
805711.desc: Reduces all damage received by 40% for 8 sec.

805713.name: Soulwarden's Resolve
805713.desc: Consumes 1 Reaped Soul Increases your armor and magic resistance based on your Stamina for 0. While active, you can use abilities as if you were in Underwalk.

805716.name: Spectral Warden
805716.desc: Summon a spectral guardian to fight along side you for 20 seconds and apply an absorption shield to up to 8 allies within 20 yds, absorbing 286 + 150% Stamina damage.

805717.name: Requiem
805717.desc: Swing at enemies around you in a fury of souls, dealing 75 + 40% AP Shadowfrost Damage, reducing their melee and ranged attack speed by -20% for 15 seconds, and generating Runic Power.

805718.name: Jailer's Bargain
805718.desc: Beckon the jailer, gaining a shield that absorbs damage equal to 30% of your maximum health for 10 seconds. While this is active you are considered Undead and are immune to fear, sleep, and charm effects.

805719.name: Soul Splinters
805719.desc: Erupt with ghastly force whenever you harvest a Reaped Soul, dealing 47 + 10.5% Stamina + 15% AP Spellshadow Damage to nearby enemies over 6 seconds.

805721.name: Shadow Wraith
805721.desc: Reduces the cooldown of Dirge by 2 sec and increases its critical strike chance by 5%.

806036.name: Ghostly Retreat
806036.desc: Heals you for 2% of your Maximum Health.

806125.name: Siphon Essence
806125.desc: Attempt to drain an enemies vitals, leeching 22 + 31.03% AP health, interrupting casting and preventing any spell from that school from being cast for 3 seconds.

806146.name: Ghastly Screech
806146.desc: Screech with ghastly intent, silencing all enemies within 8 yds for 4 seconds, and dealing 90 + 25% AP Shadowfrost Damage at the end of the duration.

806161.name: Harvest
806161.desc: Desolate damage increased by 3%. Healing taken increased by 2%.

806600.name: Possess
806600.desc: Your soul possesses an target enemy for 15 sec, Slowing their Movement Speed by 0%. At the end of the duration you will erupt from the target, dealing 400 Shadow Damage to them and granting you a Reaped Soul. While possessing an enemy your physical body cannot be attacked. While you have 3 Reaped Souls, the cooldown of this ability is reduced by 0%.

806836.name: Soulrot DEPRECATED
806836.desc: Requires Soul Infusion Curse an enemy, dealing 141 Spectral Damage and harvesting a Soul Fragment every 2 sec for 18 sec. If Soulrot is dispelled, the remaining cooldown is reduced by 1.2 sec.

807084.name: Improved Ghost Form
807084.desc: Increases your speed while in Ghost Form by 40%.

807234.name: Wraith Claw
807234.desc: 2 Charges,15 sec recharge Chill an enemy with a ghostly claw, slowing and stealing 50% of their movement speed for 8 sec. Whenever you kill an enemy, refund a charge of this ability. Scales with modifiers to Ghost Claw.

807397.name: Soul Tap
807397.desc: Chip away at the very essence of your own soul, generating 50 Runic Power. Usable while stealthed.

807419.name: Reaver
807419.desc: Adds an 10% additional Shadow Damage to the damage dealt by Ghostly Weapon.

807776.name: Anxiety
807776.desc: Increases the target's chance to miss attacks by 25%.

887018.name: CoA Aura - Reaper Class
887018.desc: Tuning aura for Reaper Class. Modifies damage dealt, damage taken, and healing done.

887081.name: CoA Aura - Reaper - Harvest
887081.desc: Tuning aura for Reaper - Harvest. Modifies damage dealt, damage taken, and healing done.

887082.name: CoA Aura - Reaper - Soul
887082.desc: Tuning aura for Reaper - Soul. Modifies damage dealt, damage taken, and healing done.

887083.name: CoA Aura - Reaper - Domination
887083.desc: Tuning aura for Reaper - Domination. Modifies damage dealt, damage taken, and healing done.
